ContentHash.description:
`sha256:<64 lowercase hex>`. The algorithm is named in the value so a later
algorithm is an additive change (OV-14).

Deployment.description:
How a Module is deployed. `Plugin` names a deployment, never a role, and is
reserved: Phase 1 refuses it as `Unsupported` (MA-1, MA-32, MA-46).

oneOf.description:
A Rust trait, compiled in. Rust has no stable ABI, so this is the default
and out-of-process is the Plugin path (Vision §62).
Out-of-process, a typed protocol; reserved (MA-32, MA-46).

ModuleId.description:
Names a Module implementation in the registry (`05-module-api.md` MA-19).

The reverse-DNS-ish namespaced form (`ezsdr.test.provider`) is what keeps two
vendors' Modules from colliding; the Kernel checks the shape, not the authority.

Rule: MA-19.

Namespace.description:
A dotted sequence of [`Ident`]s owned by a Vocabulary or a Module,
matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*(\.[a-z][a-z0-9_]*)*$`.

Rule: SB-1.

Role.description:
The five roles. There is exactly one trait each and no shared lifecycle
supertrait: one trait forced onto radios and executors alike is what audit
Finding 22 rejects, and Link and Authority have no lifecycle at all.

Rule: MA-1, MA-2.

VocabularyRequirement.description: A Vocabulary a Module declares, with its caret requirement (MA-32).

id.description: The Vocabulary's namespace, which is also its key prefix (MA-34).

impl_hash.description: Its code's content hash, which the Manifest records (RS-45).

kernel_api.description: The Kernel API it was built against; a differing major is refused (MA-32).

roles.description: The roles it holds; they must match the factories it registers (MA-31).
